subject: design/implement-now-authenticated-review-obligations
statement: `review-obligation/v1`, `review-attempt/v1`, and `review-terminal/v1` form a separate closed `implement-now-review-state/v1` event family behind `ReviewObligationStore`. Its production adapter uses one configured fetched git ref, the canonical identity/encoding and producer-proof primitives supplied by `routing-evidence-v1`, immutable identity-derived files, fast-forward compare-and-swap, exact-read proofs, and fresh-clone reduction. It does not add an undeclared event kind to the sibling's closed `routing-evidence/v1` schema, duplicate EVT-10, or authorize review from a report projection. The ref name and sharding are repository configuration/implementation data, not literals in this design.
